cases.text: A padded platform fastens directly to window glass using four suction cups so an indoor cat can nap in the sun. Includes replacement cups; no floor-standing tower.
A pressure-activated gel mat for a large dog to lie on during hot weather. Wipes clean, folds for travel, and needs neither a battery nor refrigeration.
A matched neck and bridge set of passive humbuckers, four-conductor leads and mounting rings. Solder into a six-string solid-body instrument; the instrument and amp are not included.
A two-screw brass band and protective cap sized for an alto sax mouthpiece. The band holds the reed in place; neither a mouthpiece nor reeds come in the pack.
Presterilized double-zip freezer pouches with date panels and a pour spout for expressed breast milk. Single-use, 180 ml capacity, compatible with pump adapters.
Two silicone replacement teats, medium flow, for wide-neck infant feeding bottles. Fits the broad screw ring. Only the teats are supplied, not complete bottles or pacifiers.
A zip-around neoprene pouch hugs a 14-inch notebook computer. Thin enough to slide into a commuter backpack; no handles, shoulder strap, wheels, or built-in stand.
A spring-balanced articulated arm clamps to the desk and suspends a podcast microphone above the keyboard. Internal cable channel and 5/8-inch thread adapter; microphone sold separately.
An F-style sliding jaw on a 600 mm steel rail holds glued wooden panels together. A squeeze trigger advances the jaw and a release lever opens it; protective pads prevent marking timber.
A straight copper press-fit socket joins two equal 22 mm drinking-water pipes end to end. Integral sealing rings, no valve, no bend, and no electrical wiring function.
An ultralight folding burner screws onto a threaded isobutane canister to boil a pot of water while trekking. Piezo ignition, three pot supports, and a tiny storage pouch. Fuel and cookware excluded.
Two soft zippered sacks each hold one dress shoe, keeping dusty soles away from shirts inside a suitcase. Not designed for washing clothes or carrying a laptop.
Three rectangular mesh-top zipper cubes compress and separate folded outfits inside a carry-on. They organize luggage and have no wheels, waterproof seal, or shoulder strap.
A welded-seam ten-litre sack closes by rolling its top three times and clipping the buckle. Keeps a change of clothes dry in a kayak; not a drinking reservoir or backpack.
A flexible two-litre water reservoir with a wide refill opening, drinking hose and bite valve. Slides into an existing trail pack; no backpack shell or shoulder straps are included.
A pair of waterproof bags hook onto either side of a bicycle's rear rack. Quick-release rail hooks and reflective panels; meant to carry touring gear, not to be worn on the rider's back.
